name: oligomer_linkage
label: Oligomer linkage
description: Extracts the share of 3'-5' and 2'-5' linkages and how they were determined.
system_prompt: Extract values from a scientific paper. Report only what the paper states.
intro: Extracts the share of 3'-5' and 2'-5' linkages and how they were determined. For every set (and sample) in the structure plan below, extract the values the paper reports. A value that holds for every set goes in ONE row with `set` ''; one that differs between sets goes in each set's row; one that differs between the samples of a set goes in each sample's row.

parameters.description: Percentage of internucleotide phosphodiester bonds that are natural 3'-5' linkages in the oligomer or product.
Percentage of internucleotide phosphodiester bonds that are unnatural 2'-5' linkages in the oligomer or product.
Evidence or enzymatic or chemical digestion used to assign linkage type (e.g. RNase T2, nuclease P1, KOH hydrolysis, 31P NMR).

rules: If the paper gives only the 3'-5' share or only the 2'-5' share, fill that column only; do not calculate the other.
